extracted.intended_audience: short-story authors, periodical editors, and readers interested in how the Best American anthology selections are made
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the selection process and scope for inclusion in The Best American short stories anthology: a series editor compiles notable works from periodicals and a guest editor chooses the final twenty-or-so pieces for publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series editor selection of notable works
rubrics_metrics.description: Each volume's series editor selects notable works from hundreds of periodicals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The series editor's role is to survey a wide range of periodicals and identify 'notable works' as candidates for the volume. (Original wording: 'Each volume's series editor selects notable works from hundreds of periodicals.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest editor final selection
rubrics_metrics.description: A special guest editor, a leading writer in the field, then chooses the best twenty or so pieces to publish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guest editor makes the final selection from the series editor's candidates, typically choosing about twenty pieces for inclusion. (Original wording: 'A special guest editor, a leading writer in the field, then chooses the best twenty or so pieces to publish.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope — American/Canadian short fiction and contemporary focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The series showcases American and Canadian short stories and 21st-century American and Canadian fiction (topics listed include 'Short stories, American', 'Short stories, Canadian', 'American fiction -- 21st century', 'Canadian fiction -- 21st century').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works considered are framed by geographic (American/Canadian) and temporal (21st century) categories as reflected in the anthology's topical focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reputation and editorial uniqueness
rubrics_metrics.description: Since 1915 the Best American series is described as the premier annual showcase for the country's finest short fiction and nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The combination of a series editor compiling notable works and a guest editor making final selections is presented as a 'unique system' that contributes to the series' prestige and popularity. This contextual note implies selection emphasizes literary distinction and broad surveying of periodicals. (Original wording: 'Since 1915 the Best American series is the premier annual showcase for the country's finest short fiction and nonfiction... This unique system has made the Best American series the most respected, and most popular, of its kind.')
